pythonFunction.name: file_warranty_claim
pythonFunction.description: Checks warranty coverage for the caller's device on file and files a replacement claim. Needs login. Call with the damage answers empty to check coverage; call again with both damage answers and confirmed false to get the claim terms (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED); after the caller agrees, call again with confirmed true to file. A swollen battery, smoke or overheating gives an urgent expedited claim and returns safety_advice.
